q18637.en: Motor vehicles (autoveicoli) are motor vehicles with at least four wheels, excluding quadricycles.

explain.short: This is the exact definition: an engine, four or more wheels, and quadricycles are left out.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'esclusi' means 'excluded': quadricycles are NOT autoveicoli.

sceneParams.caption: Engine + 4 or more wheels, but no quadricycles

q18638.en: A motor vehicle (autoveicolo) is a motor vehicle with no fewer than four wheels, except quadricycles.

explain.short: 'No fewer than four' is the same as 'at least four'. With the engine and without quadricycles, this is the correct definition.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'non meno di quattro' = 'at least four'; 'eccetto' = 'except'.

sceneParams.caption: At least 4 wheels, engine, quadricycles excluded

q18639.en: The bus is classified as a motor vehicle (autoveicolo).

explain.short: A bus has an engine and at least four wheels, so it is an autoveicolo.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'autoveicolo' is the big family; 'autobus' is one member of it.

sceneParams.caption: Bus: engine + 4 or more wheels = autoveicolo

q18640.en: The lorry (autocarro) is a motor vehicle (autoveicolo).

explain.short: A lorry has an engine and at least four wheels, so it belongs to the autoveicoli.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'autocarro' (lorry, for goods) is not 'autovettura' (car), but both are 'autoveicoli'.

sceneParams.caption: Lorry: engine + 4 or more wheels = autoveicolo

explain.short: The law excludes quadricycles from the autoveicoli, even though they have four wheels and an engine.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli' have four wheels, but the definition says 'esclusi': they are not autoveicoli.

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles: 4 wheels, but not autoveicoli

q18642.en: Motor vehicles (autoveicoli) are all motor vehicles with four or more wheels, including quadricycles.

explain.short: Quadricycles are excluded from the autoveicoli, not included.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'compresi' (including) is the trap: the correct word is 'esclusi' (excluded).

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles are EXCLUDED, not included

q18643.en: Motor vehicles (autoveicoli) are all vehicles with at least two wheels.

explain.short: Autoveicoli need at least four wheels and an engine. Two-wheelers are motorcycles or mopeds, not autoveicoli.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'almeno due ruote' is wrong: the definition says at least FOUR wheels.

sceneParams.caption: Autoveicoli need at least 4 wheels, not 2

q18644.en: Motor vehicles (autoveicoli) are all vehicles with at least four wheels, including those without an engine.

explain.short: An autoveicolo must have an engine. A vehicle without an engine, like a trailer, is not an autoveicolo.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'compresi quelli senza motore' is the trap: no engine means no autoveicolo.

sceneParams.caption: No engine = not an autoveicolo

q18645.en: The motor tricycle is a motor vehicle (autoveicolo).

explain.short: A tricycle has only three wheels. Autoveicoli need at least four.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'triciclo' means three wheels: one too few for an 'autoveicolo'.

sceneParams.caption: Tricycle: 3 wheels, so not an autoveicolo

q18646.en: A motor vehicle (autoveicolo) is any motor vehicle.

explain.short: Not every motor vehicle is an autoveicolo: motorcycles, mopeds, tricycles and quadricycles are not.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'qualunque' (any) is too wide: you also need at least four wheels.

sceneParams.caption: Not ANY motor vehicle: 4+ wheels needed

q18647.en: A motor vehicle (autoveicolo) is any vehicle used to carry goods.

explain.short: An autoveicolo is defined by engine and wheels, not by what it carries. It can carry people or goods.
explain.rule: An autoveicolo (motor vehicle) has an engine and at least four wheels. Quadricycles are excluded.
explain.trap: 'qualunque veicolo adibito al trasporto di merce' is wrong: a cart for goods is not an autoveicolo.

sceneParams.caption: Defined by engine + wheels, not by goods

q18648.en: The car (autovettura) is a motor vehicle with four wheels, made to carry at most nine people, including the driver.

explain.short: This is the definition of a car: four wheels, an engine, maximum nine people with the driver.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'compreso il conducente' means the driver counts in the nine.

sceneParams.caption: Car: max 9 people, driver included

q18649.en: The car (autovettura) is one of the motor vehicles (autoveicoli).

explain.short: A car has an engine and four wheels, so it is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'fa parte' means 'belongs to': autovettura is inside the autoveicolo family.

sceneParams.caption: Car is a kind of autoveicolo

q18650.en: The car (autovettura) cannot have more than nine seats, including the driver.

explain.short: Nine seats with the driver is the maximum for a car. With more seats it is a bus.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'non può avere più di nove' = 'nine at most': correct.

sceneParams.caption: Max 9 seats, driver included

keywords.it: non può avere più di nove posti
keywords.en: cannot have more than nine seats

q18651.en: The bus is not a car (autovettura).

explain.short: A bus carries more than nine people, so it is not a car. It is still an autoveicolo.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'autobus' and 'autovettura' are both autoveicoli, but different types.

sceneParams.caption: Bus: more than 9 seats, not a car

q18652.en: Cars (autovetture) can have an electric engine.

explain.short: The definition of a car does not depend on the engine type. Electric cars are cars.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'possono' (can) is right: the type of engine does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Petrol, diesel or electric: still a car

q18653.en: Cars (autovetture) must undergo a periodic roadworthiness test (revisione).

explain.short: Cars must pass a periodic check of safety and emissions: first after 4 years, then every 2 years.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'revisione periodica' is the regular official check: it is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Revisione: after 4 years, then every 2

q18654.en: All motor vehicles with rear-wheel drive are defined as cars (autovetture).

explain.short: A car is defined by its use (carrying people, max 9 seats), not by which wheels are driven.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'trazione posteriore' (rear-wheel drive) has nothing to do with the definition.

sceneParams.caption: Drive wheels don't define a car
lines: Front or rear drive: no matter

q18655.en: Cars (autovetture) cannot tow small trailers (carrelli-appendice) or trailers.

explain.short: Cars can tow a trailer or a small luggage trailer, if they have a tow hitch and respect the weight limits.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'non possono trainare' is the trap: cars CAN tow.

sceneParams.caption: Cars can tow trailers

q18656.en: All vehicles with a front engine are defined as cars (autovetture).

explain.short: The position of the engine does not define a car. Many lorries and buses also have a front engine.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'motore anteriore' (front engine) is not part of the definition.

sceneParams.caption: Engine position doesn't define a car
lines: Engine front or back: no matter

q18657.en: The car (autovettura) is a vehicle with ten seats in total, including the driver.

explain.short: A car has at most nine seats, driver included. Ten seats is too many.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'dieci posti' (ten seats) is one more than the limit of nine.

sceneParams.caption: Max 9 seats, not 10

q18658.en: A car (autovettura) is defined as an armoured vehicle specially equipped to carry valuables.

explain.short: An armoured van for money and valuables is a special-use vehicle, not a car. A car is simply for people.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'blindato' (armoured) and 'trasporto di valori' describe a special vehicle, not a car.

sceneParams.caption: Armoured van for valuables: not a car

explain.short: A lorry carries goods; a car carries people. Both are autoveicoli, but a lorry is not a car.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'autocarro' (lorry) and 'autovettura' (car) sound similar but are different.

sceneParams.caption: Lorry carries goods, car carries people

q18660.en: The car (autovettura) can have at most five seats.

explain.short: The limit for a car is nine seats with the driver, not five. Many cars have seven seats.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'al massimo, cinque' is the trap: the real maximum is nine.

sceneParams.caption: Max 9 seats, not 5

q18661.en: Cars (autovetture) must undergo the roadworthiness test (revisione) every five years.

explain.short: The first revisione is after 4 years, then every 2 years. Never every 5 years.
explain.rule: An autovettura (car) carries people: max 9 seats including the driver. It is a type of autoveicolo.
explain.trap: 'ogni cinque anni' (every five years) is the wrong number.

sceneParams.caption: Revisione: after 4 years, then every 2

q18662.en: Trailers (rimorchi) or semi-trailers (semirimorchi) are vehicles without an engine, made to be towed.

explain.short: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine. A motor vehicle pulls them.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'privi di motore' means 'without an engine': that is what makes them trailers.

sceneParams.caption: No engine: made to be towed

q18663.en: Light trailers are those with a maximum fully-loaded mass of up to 750 kg.

explain.short: The limit for a light trailer is 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'a pieno carico' means fully loaded: the 750 kg includes the load.

sceneParams.caption: Light trailer: max 750 kg fully loaded

q18664.en: The articulated bus (autosnodato) is not classified as a trailer.

explain.short: An autosnodato is a bus made of two parts joined together, with its own engine. So it is not a trailer.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'autosnodato' is a bendy bus, not a towed vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Bendy bus has an engine: not a trailer
lines: Has an engine: not a trailer

keywords.en: is not classified as a trailer

q18665.en: The motorhome (autocaravan) is not a trailer.

explain.short: An autocaravan (camper van) has its own engine and drives by itself. So it is not a trailer.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: Do not mix 'autocaravan' (has an engine) with 'caravan' (towed).

sceneParams.caption: Motorhome drives itself: not a trailer

q18666.en: The caravan is not a trailer.

explain.short: A caravan has no engine and is towed by a car, so it IS a trailer.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'caravan' (towed) is a trailer; 'autocaravan' (motorhome) is not.

sceneParams.caption: Caravan is towed: it IS a trailer

q18667.en: Light trailers are those with a maximum fully-loaded mass of up to 500 kg.

explain.short: The limit for a light trailer is 750 kg fully loaded, not 500 kg.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: '500 kg' is the wrong number: the right one is 750 kg.

sceneParams.caption: Light trailer limit is 750 kg, not 500

q18668.en: Semi-trailers (semirimorchi) are trailers without a braking system.

explain.short: Semi-trailers are heavy and they do have brakes. Without brakes they would be very dangerous.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'privi di impianto frenante' (without brakes) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Semi-trailers DO have brakes

q18669.en: Trailers are fitted with a silencer.

explain.short: A silencer reduces engine noise. Trailers have no engine, so they have no silencer.
explain.rule: Trailers and semi-trailers have no engine and are towed. Light trailers: max 750 kg fully loaded.
explain.trap: 'silenziatore' (silencer) belongs to an engine; trailers have none.

sceneParams.caption: No engine, so no silencer

q18670.en: Junctions must be kept clear in heavy traffic.

explain.short: If you stop in a junction, cross traffic is blocked. Enter only if you can get out the other side.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'incroci' means junctions: all of them must stay free.

sceneParams.caption: Don't enter the junction if you can't exit

q18671.en: Level crossings and tram tracks must be kept clear even in heavy traffic.

explain.short: Never stop on rails: a train or tram cannot stop or swerve to avoid you.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'anche' (even) shows there is no exception for heavy traffic.

sceneParams.caption: Never wait on rails or level crossings

q18672.en: Pedestrian crossings and cycle crossings must be kept clear when queues of vehicles form.

explain.short: Pedestrians and cyclists must be able to cross. If your car stops on the crossing, they have to go around it.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'formazione di code' means a queue is forming: stop before the crossing.

sceneParams.caption: Stop before the crossing, not on it

q18673.en: Road entries (junctions, merges, car park entrances, etc.) must be kept clear even in heavy traffic.

explain.short: Other vehicles need to get in and out. If you block the entry, everything gets stuck.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'immissioni' means places where vehicles enter the road: keep them free.

sceneParams.caption: Leave road entries free for others
lines: Others can get in and out

q18674.en: Only junctions controlled by traffic lights must be kept clear when queues form.

explain.short: ALL junctions must be kept clear, with or without traffic lights.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the rule covers every junction.

sceneParams.caption: ALL junctions, not only those with lights

q18675.en: Overpasses must be kept clear in heavy traffic.

explain.short: An overpass is just a road on a bridge; nobody needs to cross there. You may queue on it.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'cavalcavia' (overpass) is not one of the places to keep free.

sceneParams.caption: Queuing on an overpass is allowed

q18676.en: Tunnels must be kept clear when queues of vehicles form.

explain.short: You may queue in a tunnel; it is not a crossing point. The rule is about places where others must pass across.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'gallerie' (tunnels) are not in the list of places to keep free.

sceneParams.caption: Queuing in a tunnel is allowed

q18677.en: Entrances to private homes must be kept clear when queues of vehicles form.

explain.short: The quiz rule lists junctions, crossings, tracks and road entries. Private house entrances are not on that list.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'abitazioni private' (private homes) are not in the official list.

sceneParams.caption: Private home entrances: not in this rule

q18678.en: Underpasses must be kept clear in heavy traffic.

explain.short: An underpass is just a road under a bridge. You may queue in it.
explain.rule: In queues keep free: all junctions, level crossings, tram tracks, pedestrian/cycle crossings and road entries.
explain.trap: 'sottovia' (underpass) is not one of the places to keep free.

sceneParams.caption: Queuing in an underpass is allowed

q18679.en: When driving in a line with other vehicles, you must not just watch the vehicle in front, but also look far ahead to check the traffic situation.

explain.short: Looking far ahead lets you see braking or problems early, before the car in front reacts.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'anche in lontananza' means 'also far away': look beyond the car ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Look far ahead, not only at the car in front

q18680.en: To help traffic flow, it is right to leave the exits of side roads clear when driving behind a line of vehicles.

explain.short: Cars from side roads must be able to come out. Stop before the side road, not in front of it.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'sbocchi' means the points where side roads come out.

sceneParams.caption: Leave a gap at side roads

q18681.en: When driving in a line with other vehicles, you must still keep the safety distance.

explain.short: In a queue cars brake suddenly. With a safety distance you can stop in time.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'ugualmente' means 'all the same': the safety distance applies in a queue too.

sceneParams.caption: Keep the safety distance, also in a queue

q18682.en: For more safety, when driving in a line with other vehicles, it is right not to get too close to the vehicle in front.

explain.short: If you are too close, you cannot stop in time when the car in front brakes.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'non avvicinarsi troppo' means 'do not get too close': keep a gap.

sceneParams.caption: Don't get too close to the car ahead
lines: Too close: no time to brake

q18683.en: For more safety, when driving in a line with other vehicles in towns, it is right to always keep the hazard lights on.

explain.short: Hazard lights are for real emergencies, like a stopped vehicle or a sudden queue on a fast road, not for normal town queues.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) and 'luci di emergenza' (hazard lights) are the trap.

sceneParams.caption: No hazard lights in normal town queues

q18684.en: When driving in a line with other vehicles, you may get distracted if you are going slowly.

explain.short: Even at low speed the car in front can stop suddenly. You must always stay focused.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'consentito distrarsi' (allowed to get distracted) is never true when driving.

sceneParams.caption: Never distracted, even at low speed

q18685.en: When driving behind in a line with other vehicles, it is right to move as far left as possible to create a free lane on the right.

explain.short: Moving left takes space from oncoming traffic. Stay in your lane on the right.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'spostarsi il più possibile a sinistra' is dangerous: you could invade the other side.

sceneParams.caption: Stay in your lane, don't move left

q18686.en: When driving in a line with other vehicles, it is right to move to the centre of the road to check the traffic situation.

explain.short: Moving to the centre puts you near oncoming traffic. Look far ahead from your own lane.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'al centro della carreggiata' (to the centre of the road) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Don't move to the centre of the road

q18687.en: Even when visibility is poor, when driving behind a vehicle raising dust it is best to overtake it at once.

explain.short: If you cannot see, you must not overtake. Slow down and increase the distance until the dust clears.
explain.rule: In a queue: keep the safety distance, look far ahead, stay in your lane and stay focused.
explain.trap: 'conviene sorpassarlo subito' (best to overtake at once) is wrong with poor visibility.

sceneParams.caption: Can't see? Don't overtake, drop back

q18688.en: When entering a built-up area, you must keep in mind that priority at junctions can change often.

explain.short: In towns there are many junctions with different signs. Check the priority at each one.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'può cambiare spesso' (can change often): do not assume the same priority everywhere.

sceneParams.caption: Check priority at every junction

q18689.en: When entering a built-up area, you must keep in mind that traffic is often slowed or stopped by vehicles that are stopped, starting or turning.

explain.short: In towns cars park, leave and turn all the time. Expect the traffic to stop and go.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'intralciato o interrotto' means 'slowed or stopped': be ready to brake.

sceneParams.caption: Town traffic stops and starts often

q18690.en: Once in a built-up area, you must keep in mind that other road users (such as pedestrians and cyclists) mix more with motor traffic.

explain.short: In towns pedestrians and cyclists are close to cars. Watch out for them all the time.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'si mescolano maggiormente' means 'mix more': they are everywhere.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians and cyclists mix with cars

q18691.en: In a built-up area you must be more attentive, careful and tolerant, because more users interact in the urban environment.

explain.short: More people use the road in towns, so more care and patience are needed.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'tolleranti' means 'tolerant / patient' with other road users.

sceneParams.caption: Town: more care and patience

q18692.en: When entering a built-up area, you must keep concentrating on driving even if there may be more reasons to get distracted.

explain.short: Shops, signs and people can distract you in towns. Keep your attention on the road.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'anche se' (even if): distractions are no excuse.

sceneParams.caption: Stay focused despite distractions

q18693.en: When entering a built-up area, you must consider that you may park at unregulated junctions.

explain.short: Parking (sosta) at junctions is forbidden: it blocks the view and the way of others.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'è possibile sostare' (you may park) is the trap: at junctions you may not.

sceneParams.caption: No parking at junctions

keywords.en: to park / stop for a while

q18694.en: In a built-up area driving in parallel lines is always allowed.

explain.short: Driving side by side in town is allowed only on roads with at least two marked lanes in your direction, not always.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is the trap: it depends on the road.

sceneParams.caption: Parallel lines: only with 2+ lanes your way
lines: Then side by side is OK

q18695.en: In a built-up area, you must consider that pedestrians and disabled people must always give way to motor vehicles.

explain.short: It is the opposite: on crossings drivers must give way to pedestrians, and be extra careful with disabled people.
explain.rule: In a built-up area (centro abitato) traffic is mixed and changes often: be more careful, patient and focused.
explain.trap: 'devono sempre dare la precedenza ai veicoli' is the trap: drivers give way.

sceneParams.caption: Drivers give way to pedestrians

q18696.en: It is forbidden to move or deface road signs.

explain.short: Moved or dirty signs give wrong or unreadable information and can cause crashes.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'imbrattare' means 'to deface / dirty', for example with paint or stickers.

sceneParams.caption: Don't move or dirty road signs

q18697.en: It is forbidden to remove road signs.

explain.short: Without the sign, drivers lose important information. Removing it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'rimuovere' means 'to remove / take away'.

sceneParams.caption: Don't remove road signs

q18698.en: Moving road signs can cause serious danger for other road users.

explain.short: A sign in the wrong place can send drivers the wrong way or hide a danger.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'pericolo grave' means 'serious danger': it is not a small matter.

sceneParams.caption: Moved signs cause serious danger

q18699.en: It is allowed to move road signs if they are not danger signs.

explain.short: No road sign may be moved, whatever its type.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'consentito' (allowed) is the trap: there is no exception for non-danger signs.

sceneParams.caption: No sign may be moved, of any type

q18700.en: It is allowed to move road signs after informing the police.

explain.short: Telling the police does not give you permission. Drivers may never move signs.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'dopo aver avvisato' (after informing) does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Telling police doesn't make it allowed

q18701.en: It is allowed to move road signs if they are barriers or traffic cones.

explain.short: Cones and barriers are signs too: they mark works or dangers. Do not move them.
explain.rule: Moving, removing or dirtying road signs is always forbidden: it can put others in serious danger.
explain.trap: 'coni stradali' (traffic cones) are road signs as well.

sceneParams.caption: Cones and barriers are signs too

q18702.en: Speed racing on roads is forbidden.

explain.short: Racing on public roads puts everyone in danger, so it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'gareggiare in velocità' means 'to race'.

sceneParams.caption: No racing on roads

q18703.en: A driver who takes part in unauthorised speed races in public areas is punished with imprisonment.

explain.short: Taking part in an illegal race is a crime, punished with prison (reclusione).
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'reclusione' means prison: this is a crime, not just a fine.

sceneParams.caption: Illegal race = crime, prison

q18704.en: A driver who races on public roads is punished with imprisonment.

explain.short: Racing on public roads is a crime, punished with prison (reclusione).
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'reclusione' means prison: the most serious type of punishment.

sceneParams.caption: Racing on public roads = prison

q18705.en: Anyone who bets on vehicles taking part in unauthorised speed races on public roads is punished with imprisonment.

explain.short: Not only the drivers: people who bet on illegal races also commit a crime and risk prison.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'chi scommette' (whoever bets) is also punished, not only the driver.

sceneParams.caption: Betting on illegal races: also prison

q18706.en: Sports competitions with vehicles in public areas are allowed without authorisation.

explain.short: Any sports competition on public roads needs an official authorisation and the road closed to traffic.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'senza autorizzazione' (without authorisation) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Competitions need authorisation

q18707.en: On public roads speed races are allowed, even if not authorised, from 23:00 to 6:00.

explain.short: Unauthorised races are forbidden at any hour. Night time is no exception.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 23.00 alle ore 6.00' is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: No illegal races, day or night

q18708.en: Speed races are allowed, even if not authorised, as long as only two cars take part.

explain.short: The number of cars does not matter. Every unauthorised race is forbidden.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'purché partecipino solo due autovetture' is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: Two cars racing is still forbidden

q18709.en: On public roads speed races are allowed, even if not authorised, between motorcycles but not between motor vehicles.

explain.short: The type of vehicle does not matter. Unauthorised races are forbidden for motorcycles too.
explain.rule: Unauthorised speed races on public roads are forbidden and punished with prison, also for those who bet.
explain.trap: 'tra motocicli' (between motorcycles) is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle races are forbidden too

q18710.en: It is forbidden to throw lit cigarette ends out of the window.

explain.short: A lit cigarette end can hit a motorcyclist or start a fire. Throwing it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'mozziconi accesi' means lit cigarette ends: double danger.

sceneParams.caption: Never throw cigarette ends out

q18711.en: Throwing lit cigarette ends out of the window is very dangerous, especially if two-wheeled vehicles are coming.

explain.short: A lit cigarette end can hit a motorcyclist or cyclist in the face and make them fall.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'sopraggiungono' means 'are coming up (from behind)'.

sceneParams.caption: Cigarette ends can hit motorcyclists

q18712.en: Throwing lit cigarette ends out of the window near woods or green areas could cause fires.

explain.short: Dry grass and trees burn easily. One cigarette end can start a forest fire.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'potrebbe causare incendi' means 'could cause fires': a real risk.

sceneParams.caption: Cigarette ends can start fires

q18713.en: It is forbidden to spread mud or debris on the roads with the vehicle's dirty wheels.

explain.short: Mud and debris make the road slippery and dangerous. You must not dirty the road.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'spargere' means 'to spread / scatter'.

sceneParams.caption: Don't spread mud on the road

q18714.en: A driver who notices that the vehicle is losing oil must take all necessary action to avoid danger for other users.

explain.short: Oil on the road is very slippery. The driver must act to stop the danger, for example stop and fix it.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'tutte le azioni necessarie' means 'all necessary actions': a real duty.

sceneParams.caption: Losing oil? Act to avoid danger

q18715.en: A driver who notices heavy oil or fuel leaks from the vehicle must immediately warn the road owner or the police.

explain.short: A big oil or fuel leak is a serious danger. The road owner or police must know at once to clean and protect the road.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'immediatamente' (immediately): do it at once.

sceneParams.caption: Big leak: warn road owner or police

q18716.en: The rider of a two-wheeled vehicle may carry a pet, if it is kept in a suitable cage, as long as it does not stick out more than 50 centimetres.

explain.short: On two wheels a pet must be in a proper cage, and the load must not stick out more than 50 cm.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'apposita gabbia' (proper cage) and '50 centimetri' are both conditions.

sceneParams.caption: Pet on a moto: in a cage, max 50 cm out

q18717.en: When driving a vehicle, the driver must go slowly over puddles.

explain.short: Going fast through puddles splashes pedestrians and can make you lose grip (aquaplaning).
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'pozzanghere' means puddles.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down over puddles

q18718.en: If, coming out of a muddy track, you make the road very dirty, you can get an administrative fine.

explain.short: Dirtying the road is forbidden, and the punishment is an administrative fine (sanzione amministrativa).
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'sanzione amministrativa' means an administrative penalty, like a fine.

sceneParams.caption: Dirtying the road: fine

q18719.en: To avoid dirtying the carriageway, you must clean the vehicle's wheels before coming out of a muddy track.

explain.short: Clean wheels do not leave mud on the road, so the road stays safe.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'pulire le ruote' means 'clean the wheels'.

sceneParams.caption: Clean the wheels before the road

q18720.en: Coming out of a muddy track or a building site, you must make sure that no soil falls while driving and dirties the road.

explain.short: Soil falling from the vehicle makes the road slippery. Check before you drive on.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'terriccio' means soil / earth.

sceneParams.caption: No soil falling on the road

q18721.en: It is allowed to move temporary vertical road signs to park the vehicle.

explain.short: Temporary signs (for works or events) must not be moved, not even to park.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'temporanei' (temporary) signs are still signs: no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Never move signs to park

q18722.en: It is allowed to throw paper out of the window.

explain.short: Nothing may be thrown from a vehicle: it dirties the road and can hit others.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'consentito' (allowed) is the trap: throwing is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Don't throw paper out of the window

q18723.en: The driver may throw objects out of the window onto the hard shoulder.

explain.short: Throwing objects is forbidden anywhere, including the banchina (hard shoulder / verge).
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'sulla banchina' (onto the verge) does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No throwing, not even on the verge

q18724.en: On a road covered with fine gravel the driver may drive at high speed.

explain.short: Gravel reduces grip and stones can fly and hit other vehicles. You must drive slowly.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'velocità sostenuta' (high speed) is the trap on 'brecciolino' (fine gravel).

sceneParams.caption: Gravel: drive slowly

q18725.en: The driver may pass queuing vehicles by accelerating sharply and changing lanes repeatedly.

explain.short: Weaving through a queue with sudden acceleration is dangerous and forbidden.
explain.rule: Do not throw things, dirty the road or move signs; drive gently where you could splash or throw stones.
explain.trap: 'bruscamente' (sharply) and 'ripetutamente' (repeatedly) describe dangerous driving.

sceneParams.caption: No weaving through queues
